tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Each member of the Board shall be paid at the rate of pay payable for level III of the Executive Schedule for each day (including travel time) such member is engaged in the work of the Board.

tree.heading: Travel expenses
tree.text: Each member of the Board may receive travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, in the same manner as is permitted under sections 5702 and 5703 of title 5.

notes.text: References in TextLevel III of the Executive Schedule, referred to in subsec. (a), is set out in section 5314 of Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.
Codification Pub. L. 100–202 and Pub. L. 100–203 added identical sections.
